title: salvia pratensis subsp. bertolonii
intro: Salvia pratensis subsp. bertolonii, commonly known as Bertoloni's meadow sage, is a subspecies of the perennial herb Salvia pratensis, native to Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and aiding in the management of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Bertoloni's meadow sage are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
